advisor.enabled.doc: Run the LLM configuration advisor. On by default; needs a usable LLM at startup. Its changes execute only through the policy gate and trust level. Default: true.

agentdb.reconcile_interval_seconds.doc: How often to reconcile agent-DB deployments: archive expired leases and destroy abandoned ones. 0 disables. Default: 300.

analyzer.analyze_stale_days.doc: A table whose last (auto)analyze is older than this many days, with write activity, is flagged for ANALYZE. Default: 7.

analyzer.analyze_stale_min_rows.doc: Minimum live rows before recommending ANALYZE on a stale/never-analyzed table. Default: 10000.

analyzer.autovacuum_tune_min_rows.doc: Minimum live-row count before the per-table autovacuum tuner recommends a lower scale factor. Tuning small tables is pointless. Default: 1000000.

analyzer.cache_hit_ratio_warning.doc: Warn when the shared buffers cache hit ratio falls below this fraction (0.0-1.0). Low ratios suggest shared_buffers is under-sized or working set is too large.

analyzer.checkpoint_frequency_warning_pe.doc: Warn when checkpoints occur more than this many times per hour. High frequency indicates max_wal_size is too small.

analyzer.idle_in_transaction_timeout_min.doc: Report sessions sitting in 'idle in transaction' longer than this. Long idle-in-tx sessions block vacuum and hold locks.

analyzer.index_bloat_threshold_pct.doc: Minimum bloat percentage (0-100) an index must exhibit before it becomes a REINDEX candidate.

analyzer.interval_seconds.doc: How often the analyzer runs its rule checks, in seconds. Lower values detect issues faster but add load.

analyzer.lock_chain.active_query_cancel_.doc: Minutes an active query root blocker must run before pg_cancel_backend is recommended. Default: 15.

analyzer.lock_chain.critical_blocked_thr.doc: Blocked session count that escalates finding to critical severity. Default: 10.

analyzer.lock_chain.enabled.doc: Enable lock chain detection using pg_blocking_pids(). Detects cascading lock waits.

analyzer.lock_chain.idle_in_tx_terminate.doc: Minutes an idle-in-transaction root blocker must wait before pg_terminate_backend is recommended. Default: 5.

analyzer.lock_chain.min_blocked_threshol.doc: Minimum blocked sessions before a lock chain generates a finding. Default: 3.

analyzer.lock_chain.safe_patterns.doc: Application name substrings that protect a process from automated termination/cancellation.

analyzer.regression_lookback_days.doc: How many days of pg_stat_statements history the regression detector compares against.

analyzer.regression_threshold_pct.doc: Percent latency regression required before a query is flagged as a regressor. Set low for sensitive detection, higher to reduce noise.

analyzer.seq_scan_min_rows.doc: Minimum table row count before a sequential scan is reported as a finding. Below this, a seq scan is usually cheaper than an index lookup.

analyzer.slow_query_threshold_ms.doc: Queries with mean_exec_time above this are considered slow and become candidates for optimization findings.

analyzer.slow_slot_retained_bytes.doc: Active slots retaining more WAL than this (bytes) are flagged as slow consumers. Default 1 GB. Slow consumers hold xmin, blocking vacuum.

analyzer.table_bloat_dead_tuple_pct.doc: Dead-tuple percentage threshold for reporting table bloat. Above this the analyzer emits a vacuum or repack finding.

analyzer.table_bloat_min_rows.doc: Minimum row count before a table is considered for bloat analysis. Tiny tables are noisy and not worth reporting.

analyzer.unused_index_window_days.doc: An index must be unused (idx_scan=0) for at least this many days before the analyzer suggests dropping it. Default 7 days.
analyzer.unused_index_window_days.warning: Setting this too low can recommend dropping indexes that support infrequent but critical queries (e.g. monthly reports).

analyzer.work_mem_promotion_threshold.doc: How many active work_mem hints a single role must accumulate before the analyzer recommends promoting work_mem at the role level via ALTER ROLE. Set 0 to disable the advisor.

analyzer.wraparound_freeze_xid_age.doc: Per-table transaction age (age(relfrozenxid)) at which to recommend VACUUM (FREEZE) to prevent XID wraparound. Default: 150000000.

analyzer.xid_wraparound_critical.doc: Transaction age at which the analyzer escalates to critical severity. Normally ~1.5 billion — past this autovacuum will force emergency wraparound runs.
analyzer.xid_wraparound_critical.warning: If this is hit, autovacuum enters aggressive mode and the database may eventually refuse writes.

analyzer.xid_wraparound_warning.doc: Transaction age at which the analyzer emits a wraparound warning. Normally ~200 million.

api.listen_addr.doc: Address the REST API and dashboard HTTP server binds to (host:port). Use :8080 to listen on all interfaces.

api.trusted_proxies.doc: IPs or CIDR blocks permitted to set X-Forwarded-For. Defaults to loopback only. Expand when running behind a trusted reverse proxy, load balancer, or CDN.
api.trusted_proxies.warning: Adding an untrusted or externally-reachable proxy lets attackers spoof their client IP and bypass login rate limits.

azure.resource_group.doc: Azure resource group that contains the flexible server.

azure.server_name.doc: Flexible server name for hosts that do not name it (private DNS or IP). A <name>.postgres.database.azure.com host always wins.

azure.subscription_id.doc: Azure subscription ID of the flexible server. With resource_group set, pg_sage applies server parameters through Azure Resource Manager.

clone.provider.doc: Clone provider: none, dle, or snapshot.

databases[].analyzer_interval_seconds.doc: Per-database analyzer interval override. Zero falls back to defaults.analyzer_interval_seconds.

databases[].collector_interval_seconds.doc: Per-database collector interval override. Zero falls back to defaults.collector_interval_seconds.

databases[].database.doc: Database name on the target instance.

databases[].execution_mode.doc: Per-database mode: auto follows trust/risk policy; approval queues actions; manual disables background queueing and execution. Trust never promotes manual. Defaults to fleet default or auto.

databases[].host.doc: Hostname or IP of this fleet database.

databases[].max_connections.doc: Maximum connections the sidecar pgx pool opens to this database. Falls back to defaults.max_connections when zero.

databases[].name.doc: Logical name for this database in fleet mode. Must be unique across the fleet.

databases[].password.doc: Password for the login role. Encrypted at rest using encryption_key when persisted to the meta database.

databases[].port.doc: TCP port of this fleet database.

databases[].sslmode.doc: libpq sslmode for this connection (disable, prefer, require, verify-ca, verify-full).

databases[].tags.doc: Free-form tags used to group databases for fleet operations (e.g. tier=prod, team=payments).

databases[].trust_level.doc: Per-database override of the global trust.level. Useful for running a pilot database in autonomous while the fleet stays in advisory.

databases[].user.doc: Login role the sidecar uses to connect to this fleet database.

defaults.analyzer_interval_seconds.doc: Default analyzer interval applied to fleet databases that don't set their own value.

defaults.collector_interval_seconds.doc: Default collector interval applied to fleet databases that don't set their own value.

defaults.execution_mode.doc: Default action execution mode applied to fleet databases that don't set their own value. One of auto, approval, manual.

defaults.max_connections.doc: Default max_connections applied to fleet databases that don't set their own value.

defaults.trust_level.doc: Default trust level applied to fleet databases. Falls back to the global trust.level when unset.

encryption_key.doc: Passphrase used to encrypt sensitive fleet-mode fields (per-database passwords). Rotate via the key-rotation runbook.

explain.cache_ttl_minutes.doc: TTL for cached explain results. Default: 60.

explain.enabled.doc: Enable the LLM-powered natural language EXPLAIN API endpoint.

explain.max_tokens.doc: Maximum LLM output tokens for explain responses. Default: 4096.

explain.timeout_ms.doc: statement_timeout for EXPLAIN ANALYZE execution. Default: 10000.

forecaster.alert_horizons.doc: Days-until-full thresholds that generate findings. Default: [30, 7, 3].

forecaster.disk_capacity_bytes.doc: Total disk capacity in bytes, for the disk runway and disk-full credit. 0 = undeclared: nothing auto-detects it, so no disk runway or credit. Managed services are never credited.

forecaster.min_data_points.doc: Minimum data points required before generating a forecast. Default: 24.

forecaster.min_r_squared.doc: Minimum R-squared for forecast reliability. Below this, findings are info-only. Default: 0.5.

llm.api_key.doc: Authentication token for the LLM provider. Prefer sourcing from environment via ${LLM_API_KEY} rather than committing literal values.

llm.context_budget_tokens.doc: Maximum tokens attached as context (schema, stats, plans) to a single LLM request. Prevents oversized prompts from busting the model context window.

llm.cooldown_seconds.doc: Per-prompt dedup window and breaker cooldown: an identical request is not re-sent within this many seconds; after 3 provider failures calls pause this long. Not a global rate limit.

llm.enabled.doc: Global enable for LLM-assisted analysis. On by default; calls a provider only once llm.endpoint and llm.api_key are set. When off, pg_sage uses deterministic heuristics only.

llm.endpoint.doc: LLM provider base URL. Supports OpenAI-compatible chat-completions endpoints. Can be left blank to use the vendor default.

llm.fleet_token_budget_daily.doc: Fleet-wide daily token cap split per database so one noisy database can't drain the whole budget. 0 disables per-database budgeting (fleet mode only).

llm.json_mode.doc: When true, requests structured JSON via response_format: json_object. Supported by OpenAI, Gemini (OpenAI-compat), Groq, Ollama. Off for providers that reject unknown fields.

llm.model.doc: Model identifier sent to the provider (e.g. gpt-4o-mini). Must support JSON-mode responses for structured outputs.

llm.optimizer.enabled.doc: Run the LLM index optimizer. On by default; needs a usable LLM. Its index changes execute only through the policy gate and trust level. Default: true.

llm.optimizer_llm.api_key.doc: API key for the optimizer LLM. Prefer env-var substitution over literal values.

llm.optimizer_llm.cooldown_seconds.doc: Minimum seconds between two optimizer LLM requests.

llm.optimizer_llm.enabled.doc: Enable the dedicated reasoning-tier LLM used by the index optimizer. When false the optimizer falls back to the general llm.* client. Default: false.

llm.optimizer_llm.endpoint.doc: Base URL for the optimizer LLM provider. Can differ from the general llm.endpoint when the reasoning tier lives on another provider.

llm.optimizer_llm.fallback_to_general.doc: If true, fall back to the general llm.* client when the optimizer LLM is unavailable or over budget.

llm.optimizer_llm.max_output_tokens.doc: Upper bound on output tokens accepted from the optimizer LLM. Truncates runaway responses.

llm.optimizer_llm.model.doc: Reasoning-tier model identifier (e.g. o1-mini). Must return JSON when requested.

llm.optimizer_llm.timeout_seconds.doc: Per-request timeout for optimizer LLM calls. Reasoning models typically need longer timeouts than chat models.

llm.optimizer_llm.token_budget_daily.doc: Daily token cap for the optimizer LLM — independent of the general llm.token_budget_daily so reasoning spend can be tracked separately.

llm.timeout_seconds.doc: HTTP request timeout for each LLM call. Low values protect the analyzer cycle from slow providers; high values tolerate cold-start latency.

llm.token_budget_daily.doc: Soft daily cap on total tokens (input + output) the sidecar will spend on LLM requests. Once exceeded the LLM is skipped until the next UTC day.

logwatch.dedup_window_seconds.doc: Suppress duplicate log signals within this window. Default: 60.

logwatch.enabled.doc: Enable RCA logs from a configured provider API or local PostgreSQL jsonlog/csvlog files. Requires rca.enabled=true.

logwatch.exclude_applications.doc: Application names excluded from timeout/deadlock signals. Default: pg_sage.

logwatch.format.doc: Log format: jsonlog (PG15+) or csvlog. Auto-detected if blank.

logwatch.log_directory.doc: Path to PG log directory. Auto-detected from pg_settings if blank.

logwatch.max_line_len_bytes.doc: Discard log lines longer than this. Default: 65536.

logwatch.max_lines_per_cycle.doc: Stop parsing after this many lines per drain cycle. Default: 10000.

logwatch.poll_interval_ms.doc: Fallback poll interval when fsnotify is unavailable. Default: 1000.

logwatch.slow_query_enabled.doc: Opt-in: parse log_min_duration_statement output as log_slow_query signals. Default: false.

logwatch.temp_file_min_bytes.doc: Minimum temp file size to trigger log_temp_file_created. Default: 10485760.

meta_db.doc: DSN of the metadata database used in fleet mode to persist cross-target state. Blank in standalone mode.

migration.ddl_row_threshold.doc: Row count below which DDL is considered low-risk. Default: 10000.

migration.log_detection.doc: Parse DDL from PG logs (requires log_statement=ddl).

migration.managed_service.doc: Cloud provider: none, rds, aurora, cloudsql, alloydb, neon, supabase. Filters unavailable recommendations.

migration.mode.doc: Operating mode: advisory (default). Active mode deferred to future release.

migration.poll_interval_seconds.doc: How often to poll during active DDL. Default: 5.

mode.doc: Operating mode: standalone, fleet, or meta. Standalone connects to one PostgreSQL target; fleet manages many databases from one sidecar.

notification_policy.allow_private_target.doc: Allow webhook and SMTP channels to target loopback, RFC 1918, ULA or CGNAT hosts and plain http (e.g. an internal SMTP relay). Metadata and link-local stay blocked. Requires restart.

oauth.client_id.doc: OAuth client ID issued by the provider when the pg_sage application was registered.

oauth.client_secret.doc: OAuth client secret issued by the provider. Source from an environment variable in production.

oauth.default_role.doc: Role assigned to newly authenticated users when no role mapping rule matches.

oauth.enabled.doc: Enable OAuth single sign-on for the sidecar UI. When false, the UI falls back to local auth.

oauth.issuer_url.doc: OIDC issuer URL used to discover the provider's authorization and token endpoints.

oauth.provider.doc: OAuth provider identifier. Supported values include google, github, okta, and generic OIDC.

oauth.redirect_url.doc: Absolute URL the provider redirects to after authentication. Must match the URI registered at the provider.

policy.profile.doc: Bootstrap standing-policy profile: staffed or unattended.

postgres.database.doc: Target database name the sidecar connects to. Ignored when database_url is set.

postgres.database_url.doc: Full libpq connection URL. When set, overrides host/port/user/password/database/sslmode.

postgres.host.doc: Hostname or IP of the target PostgreSQL instance. Ignored when database_url is set.

postgres.max_connections.doc: Maximum connections the sidecar pgx pool will open to this target. Keep well below max_connections on the server.

postgres.password.doc: Password for the sidecar login role. Prefer environment-variable substitution or a secrets manager over committing literal values.

postgres.port.doc: TCP port of the target PostgreSQL instance. Ignored when database_url is set.

postgres.sslmode.doc: libpq sslmode string (disable, allow, prefer, require, verify-ca, verify-full). Use verify-full in production.

postgres.user.doc: PostgreSQL login role used by the sidecar. Requires pg_read_all_stats plus write access to the sage schema.

rca.connection_saturation_pct.doc: Percentage of max_connections that triggers the connections_high signal. Default: 80.

rca.dedup_window_minutes.doc: Time window for deduplicating incidents with the same signals and root object. Default: 30.

rca.enabled.doc: Enable the root cause analysis engine. Correlates multiple signals into unified incident narratives.

rca.escalation_cycles.doc: Consecutive analyzer cycles an incident stays open before escalating warning to critical. Default: 5.

rca.llm_correlation_threshold.doc: Minimum concurrent signals to trigger LLM-based correlation (Tier 2). Default: 3.

rca.lock_chain_interval_seconds.doc: Seconds between lock-chain fast-path checks, which open or update the lock_contention incident between analyzer cycles. 0 disables the fast path; otherwise 10-3600. Default: 60.

rca.narration_enabled.doc: Add an LLM narrative, citing the incident's evidence and catalog probe results, to incident notifications. Off, no LLM, or any LLM failure uses the deterministic summary. Default: true.

rca.replication_lag_threshold_seconds.doc: Seconds of replay lag before the replication_lag_increasing signal fires. Default: 30.

rca.resolution_cycles.doc: Consecutive clear cycles before an incident auto-resolves. Default: 2.

rca.wal_spike_multiplier.doc: WAL bytes delta must exceed previous delta by this multiplier to trigger wal_growth_spike. Default: 2.0.

runaway.enabled.doc: Enable policy-based runaway query detection and escalation (warn -> cancel -> terminate).

runaway.safe_patterns.doc: Application name substrings protected from runaway termination. Merged with lock_chain.safe_patterns at startup.

safety.backoff_consecutive_skips.doc: After this many consecutive skipped cycles (e.g. CPU ceiling hit repeatedly), enter dormant mode and slow the cadence until load subsides.

safety.cpu_ceiling_pct.doc: Skip cycles when database-host CPU exceeds this percent (1-100). Prevents pg_sage from adding load during incidents.

safety.ddl_timeout_seconds.doc: Timeout applied to DDL actions (CREATE INDEX, ALTER TABLE) executed by the executor. Per-statement ceiling, not per-cycle.

safety.disk_pressure_threshold_pct.doc: When database data volume usage exceeds this percent, skip write-producing actions. Prevents adding indexes to a near-full volume.

safety.dormant_interval_seconds.doc: Cycle interval (seconds) used while in dormant mode — typically much larger than the normal interval so the sidecar wakes rarely while the target is stressed.

safety.lock_timeout_ms.doc: lock_timeout applied to connections running DDL or ANALYZE. Must be > 0 for ANALYZE actions in v0.8.5 — autovacuum can hold a ShareUpdateExclusiveLock indefinitely.
safety.lock_timeout_ms.warning: Zero disables the timeout entirely and is refused by the executor for ANALYZE actions.

safety.query_timeout_ms.doc: statement_timeout applied to every collector and analyzer query issued by the sidecar. Protects the target from runaway introspection.

schema_lint.exclude_schemas.doc: Schemas to exclude. Default: pg_catalog, information_schema.

schema_lint.include_schemas.doc: Schemas to scan. Empty means all non-system schemas.

schema_lint.min_table_rows.doc: Ignore findings on tables below this row count. Default: 1000.

schema_lint.scan_interval_minutes.doc: How often to run the full schema lint scan. Default: 60.

sre.actions.approval_ttl_minutes.doc: Minutes an action approval request stays open before it expires, 1-60. Default: 15.

sre.actions.chatops_tolerance_seconds.doc: Maximum age (and clock skew) of a signed Slack approval callback, 30-900 seconds. Default: 300.

sre.actions.max_evidence_age_seconds.doc: Oldest target identity evidence an approved cancel may act on, 1-5 seconds (5 is the ceiling). Default: 5.

sre.actions.proposals.doc: Propose an evidence-matched cancel when an investigation's root is one active blocking backend. Proposals never execute by themselves. Default: true.

sre.actions.protected_applications.doc: application_name values whose sessions are never proposed for or signalled by an action (exact names).

sre.actions.protected_roles.doc: Database roles whose sessions are never proposed for or signalled by an action (exact names).

sre.actions.recovery_deadline_minutes.doc: Minutes after an action before an unproven recovery is reported inconclusive, 1-240. Default: 30.

sre.actions.recovery_sample_seconds.doc: Seconds between recovery samples after an action, 1-300. Default: 40.

sre.actions.recovery_samples.doc: Fresh samples a recovery verdict needs, 3-20. Default: 3.

sre.actions.request_approval.doc: Queue an approved-to-run proposal in the approval queue and send it to ChatOps channels at once. Default: true.

sre.automatic_start.doc: Start read-only, bounded investigations from RCA incidents, plan_regression findings and the reactive detector (checkpoint, temp-file, LWLock). Never executes. false = on request only. Default: true.

sre.autonomy.bench_results_path.doc: PGIncidentBench JSON report, or a directory searched 3 levels deep (the CI shard reports), ingested hourly as promotion evidence, each once. Empty: upload through the API.

sre.autonomy.canary.canary_instances.doc: Databases changed and measured before the rollout widens, 1-10. Default: 1.

sre.autonomy.canary.regression_limit_pct.doc: Regression that halts and rolls back the rollout, 0-100. Default: 10.

sre.autonomy.canary.settle_seconds.doc: Seconds to wait after each change before measuring it, 0-3600. Default: 60.

sre.autonomy.concurrency_window_minutes.doc: Another pg_sage action on the same object this recent caps an action at L1, 1-1440. Default: 15.

sre.autonomy.enforce.doc: Earned-autonomy ledger restricts self-initiated incident-family actions, custodians included (L1 script, L2 approval, L3 auto). false: the trust ramp decides. Default: true.
sre.autonomy.enforce.warning: false lets incident-family actions run under the elapsed-time trust ramp without earned evidence.

sre.autonomy.evaluate_interval_minutes.doc: Minutes between promotion evaluations (pg_sage proposes, an admin approves), 5-1440. Default: 60.

sre.autonomy.failover_cooldown_minutes.doc: Minutes after a role change autonomy stays at L1, 1-1440. Default: 30.

sre.autonomy.game_days.enabled.doc: Run game days. Needs clone.provider (dle or snapshot) or local_dsn. Default: false.

sre.autonomy.game_days.families.doc: Incident families to exercise. Empty: every family the bench covers.

sre.autonomy.game_days.interval_hours.doc: Hours between scheduled game days, 24-2160. Default: 168.

sre.autonomy.game_days.local_dsn.doc: Development fallback when clone.provider is none: a disposable PostgreSQL database for game days. Never a monitored database (refused).

sre.autonomy.max_evidence_age_seconds.doc: Evidence older than this caps an action at L1, 5-3600. Default: 300.

sre.autonomy.proposal_ttl_hours.doc: Hours a promotion proposal waits for an admin, 1-720. Default: 168.

sre.autonomy.reconcile_interval_seconds.doc: Seconds between recording live outcomes of handed-off and autonomous actions, 10-3600. Default: 60.

sre.autonomy.safety_window_days.doc: Days a harmful or unsafe outcome caps its family at L1 and blocks re-promotion, 1-365. Default: 30.

sre.change_events.allowed_sources.doc: Sources allowed to submit events; empty allows any signed source.

sre.change_events.feed_enabled.doc: Poll pg_sage's own change sources (actions, config audit, DDL, statistics resets, restarts, failovers, extensions). Default: true.

sre.change_events.feed_interval_seconds.doc: Seconds between change feed polls, 15-3600. Default: 60.

sre.change_events.hmac_secret.doc: Shared secret (at least 32 bytes) signing POST /api/v1/sre/change-events. Empty disables ingestion.

sre.change_events.retention_days.doc: Days change events are kept, 1-3650. Default: 90.

sre.evidence_retention_days.doc: Days a finished, unpinned investigation keeps its probe evidence (a tombstone records the delete). 1 to timeline_retention_days. Default: 30.

sre.llm.enabled.doc: Model turn in investigations: rank the graph's hypotheses, propose one catalog probe, narrate cited claims. Used whenever an LLM is configured; false = deterministic only. Default: true.

sre.runways.disk_critical_hours.doc: A disk/WAL runway this short (hours) is critical; at most disk_horizon_hours. Default: 24.

sre.runways.disk_horizon_hours.doc: Open a disk/WAL runway finding when disk usage reaches the declared capacity, or a slot reaches its WAL maximum, this soon (hours), up to 8760. Default: 72.

sre.runways.enabled.doc: Sample runway series on the collector tick and open forecast findings when a runway crosses its horizon (wraparound, disk/WAL, sequences). Read-only. Default: true.

sre.runways.interval_seconds.doc: Seconds between runway samples, 15-3600. Default: 60 (the collector tick).

sre.runways.investigate.doc: Open a read-only pre-incident investigation for each runway finding (one per finding and severity). Independent of sre.automatic_start. Default: true.

sre.runways.lookback_hours.doc: Hours of samples a trend is measured over, 1 to sample_retention_hours (and at most 168). Default: 6.

sre.runways.min_samples.doc: Fewest samples a trend needs before it projects a runway, 3-1000. Default: 10.

sre.runways.min_span_minutes.doc: Shortest span (minutes) of samples a trend needs, 1 to the lookback. Default: 30.

sre.runways.sample_retention_hours.doc: Hours runway samples are kept, lookback_hours to 720. Default: 48.

sre.runways.sequence_critical_days.doc: A sequence runway this short (days) is critical; at most sequence_horizon_days. Default: 7.

sre.runways.sequence_horizon_days.doc: Open a sequence runway finding when a sequence reaches its binding limit this soon (days), up to 3650. Default: 30.

sre.runways.wraparound_critical_hours.doc: A wraparound runway this short (hours) is critical; at most wraparound_horizon_hours. Default: 72.

sre.runways.wraparound_horizon_hours.doc: Open a wraparound runway finding when the measured runway to the XID or multixact warning limit is this short (hours), up to 8760. Default: 336 (14 days).

sre.sample_interval_seconds.doc: Seconds between the two samples connection and WAL investigations compare, 1-30. Default: 5.

sre.slo.burn_rules[].factor.doc: Burn rate both windows must reach.

sre.slo.burn_rules[].short_window.doc: Short window, shorter than the long one.

sre.slo.enabled.doc: Evaluate SLO burn rates for each database: the database proxy SLIs and any registered app SLIs. Read-only. Default: true.

sre.slo.objectives[].bad_query.doc: PromQL for bad events over $window (use 'or vector(0)' so zero errors is not absent data).

sre.slo.objectives[].database.doc: Monitored database the service uses; empty = every database.

sre.slo.objectives[].description.doc: What the SLI measures, shown with its state.

sre.slo.objectives[].min_eligible_events.doc: Fewer eligible events in a window is low traffic (unknown). Default: 50.

sre.slo.objectives[].name.doc: Lower-case name; db_ is reserved for proxies.

sre.slo.objectives[].owner.doc: Team or person who owns the service SLO.

sre.slo.objectives[].resets_query.doc: Optional PromQL counting counter resets over $window.

sre.slo.objectives[].source.doc: Where the counters come from: prometheus or push.

sre.slo.objectives[].stale_after_seconds.doc: Pushed samples older than this are stale. Default: 300.

sre.slo.open_investigations.doc: A page-level burn of a registered app SLI opens a read-only slo_burn investigation (a proxy burn only with sre.automatic_start). Default: true.

sre.slo.prometheus.bearer_token.doc: Bearer token; prefer ${ENV} substitution or bearer_token_file.

sre.slo.prometheus.bearer_token_file.doc: File holding the bearer token (e.g. a mounted secret), read at startup.

sre.slo.prometheus.url.doc: Prometheus-compatible HTTP API base URL (query and query_range). Empty disables the connector.

sre.slo.proxies.enabled.doc: Database proxy SLIs (latency, server-class errors, connection refusal, replication lag), always labeled proxies. Default: true.

sre.slo.proxies.latency_factor.doc: Relative threshold: this times the median interval p95, at least 1. Default: 3.

sre.slo.proxies.latency_floor_ms.doc: The relative threshold is never under this. Default: 50.

sre.slo.proxies.latency_threshold_ms.doc: Absolute p95 latency threshold; 0 = relative to the database's own last-week median. Default: 0.

sre.slo.proxies.replication_lag_budget_s.doc: Replay lag over this is a bad minute, 1-86400. Default: 60.

sre.slo.proxies.top_queries.doc: Top queries by interval total time in the latency proxy, 1-100. Default: 20.

sre.slo.proxies.window_days.doc: Proxy SLO window in days, 1-90. Default: 30.

sre.slo.push.hmac_secret.doc: Shared secret (at least 32 bytes) signing POST /api/v1/sre/sli/{name}. Empty disables pushes.

sre.timeline_retention_days.doc: Days a finished, unpinned investigation is kept at all, leaving a tombstone. evidence_retention_days to 3650. Pinned and running ones are kept. Default: 90.

sre.trigger_interval_seconds.doc: Seconds between checks for new triggers and pending investigations, 5-600. Default: 15.

trust.cascade_cooldown_cycles.doc: If N consecutive cycles each propose new actions, throttle to observe impact. Prevents storm-like cascades of small changes.

trust.level.doc: Autonomy ceiling: observation is cases only; advisory auto executes eligible safe actions; autonomous auto executes eligible safe and moderate actions. Manual disables background actions.
trust.level.warning: Changing trust can expand what execution_mode=auto may execute without human review.

trust.maintenance_window.doc: Window for MODERATE auto-actions: always, never, presets (nights, weeknights, weekends), Mon-Fri 01:00-05:00, or cron (1h wide, or @30m). Optional IANA zone: weeknights America/Chicago.

trust.ramp_start.doc: RFC3339 timestamp when the trust ramp began. Auto-persisted on first startup if empty. Used to gate newly-supported actions behind a soak period.

trust.rollback_cooldown_days.doc: After a rollback, the same action family is blocked for this many days to prevent flap. Default 3 days.

trust.rollback_threshold_pct.doc: Latency regression percentage (0-100) that triggers automatic rollback of a recently applied action. Lower = more sensitive.

trust.rollback_window_minutes.doc: How many minutes after applying an action pg_sage watches for regressions before considering it stable.

trust.tier3_high_risk.doc: Enable tier-3 actions classified as high risk. Ignored outside fleet mode — standalone always forces this to false.
trust.tier3_high_risk.warning: High-risk actions can destabilize production — enable only with a reviewed rollback plan.

trust.tier3_moderate.doc: Enable typed moderate actions such as CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY after the longer trust ramp. Requires execution_mode=auto and trust.level=autonomous.
trust.tier3_moderate.warning: Moderate actions can consume IO or briefly contend for locks.

trust.tier3_safe.doc: Enable typed safe actions such as ANALYZE and non-FULL VACUUM after the trust ramp when execution_mode=auto and trust.level is advisory or autonomous.

tuner.analyze_cooldown_minutes.doc: Minimum minutes between tuner-initiated ANALYZE runs on the same table. Also respects autovacuum last_analyze as a recent-run signal.

tuner.analyze_max_table_mb.doc: Tables larger than this many MB are never auto-ANALYZEd — an advisory finding is emitted instead for operator review.
tuner.analyze_max_table_mb.warning: Default 10240 (10GB). Raise with care — ANALYZE on TB-scale tables can saturate I/O.

tuner.analyze_timeout_ms.doc: statement_timeout for ANALYZE actions. Default 600000 (10 minutes). Exceeding this marks the action failed_timeout and extends the cooldown.

tuner.enabled.doc: Master switch for the per-query tuner. When false, no hints are written and Tune() is a no-op — the analyzer still runs.

tuner.hint_retirement_days.doc: Hints older than this many days are retired unconditionally, regardless of current query behavior. Safety net against stale hint accumulation.

tuner.llm_enabled.doc: Allow the tuner to call the LLM for hint prescription when deterministic rules do not produce a recommendation. Budget-gated by llm.token_budget_daily. Default: true.

tuner.max_concurrent_analyze.doc: Hard cap on concurrent ANALYZE actions across the entire sidecar process (shared semaphore — fleet-wide, not per-database). Default 1.

tuner.min_query_calls.doc: Require at least this many pg_stat_statements.calls before the tuner will act on a query. Filters out one-offs.

tuner.nested_loop_row_threshold.doc: Minimum actual-row count on a nested-loop inner that triggers the bad-nested-loop symptom. Smaller values increase sensitivity.

tuner.parallel_min_table_rows.doc: Threshold for suggesting parallel-enable hints on large sequential scans. Tables smaller than this are assumed not to benefit from parallelism.

tuner.plan_time_ratio.doc: When plan_time / exec_time exceeds this ratio, the tuner flags the query as plan-time-dominated and considers prepared-statement hints.

tuner.revalidation_explain_timeout_ms.doc: Reserved; currently has no effect. The revalidation loop issues no EXPLAIN queries. Kept so existing config files still load.

tuner.revalidation_interval_hours.doc: How often the hint revalidation loop runs. Set to 0 to disable the loop entirely. Default 24 hours.

tuner.revalidation_keep_ratio.doc: Reserved; no effect. Revalidation does no hinted-vs-unhinted cost comparison (it uses age, missing objects, stale queryids, latency). Kept so existing configs load.

tuner.revalidation_rollback_ratio.doc: Reserved; currently has no effect. No hinted-vs-unhinted cost comparison is performed. Kept so existing config files still load.

tuner.stale_stats_age_minutes.doc: Both manual and autovacuum last_analyze must be older than this many minutes before the table is considered stale. Default 60.

tuner.stale_stats_estimate_skew.doc: Ratio ActualRows / PlanRows above which a plan node is considered row-estimate skewed. Default 10 — same threshold as the bad-nested-loop check.

tuner.stale_stats_mod_ratio.doc: Fraction of rows modified since last ANALYZE (n_mod_since_analyze / reltuples) required to treat a table as stale. Default 0.1 = 10%.

tuner.verify_after_apply.doc: Run the daily hint revalidation loop. Removes hints that have become redundant, harmful, or broken. Requires pg_hint_plan.
tuner.verify_after_apply.warning: v0.8.5 activates a real background cycle here — upgrade note: if you want v0.8.4 inert behavior, set this to false before upgrading.

tuner.work_mem_max_mb.doc: Maximum per-query work_mem (MB) the tuner is allowed to prescribe via Set(work_mem) hints. Ceiling prevents runaway memory suggestions.

verify.min_gain_pct.doc: Minimum gain required to retain a change.
